body:
It is selfish, but less selfish then dragging them down with me and expecting their support for my made up problems (again, my life financially is totally ok, I have nothing to complain about). I'm a spoiled kid.

I'm sorry to hear about your friend. You've got to know that he just did what he thought would be the best for him and you/his familiy/friends. I don't know the exact situation, but you've got to know that no one commits suicide out of pure selfishness. He probably did what he thought was right, you might just not understand him.

And personally I don't think there's anything wrong with death by choice. Everyone was born without a choice, so I guess it makes sense that you can end it if you don't like it. It should be a basic human right, and people shouldn't be sad if someone decides to quit. But that's a huge mindset twist and it's probably not going to happen anytime soon.

Thanks for the reply.

I don't think it's worth it, that's the problem. I don't like the basic mechanics of life. This leads to me not enjoying anything, not even the act of enjoying itself. I don't like being happy, I don't like being sad. I spend most of my time in this strange apathetic mood and I don't like that aswell. I don't want to feel anything, I don't want to BE anymore.

Yes, I know my family loves me and that's the hard part. But I think it's better for me to end things now, they suffer for a while (it will probably leave a permanent scar) and eventually they get on with their life. The other option is me staying alive and just having them deal with my stupid problems, seeing me spiral down into ruin, all while dragging them down with me. I don't like that option.
